# Game Idea: Canvas Chaos

A minimalist endless‑runner on an HTML canvas where the player controls a constantly moving square that must dodge procedurally generated obstacles (spikes, gaps, moving blocks). The player can jump or slide. **Lose condition:** collision with any obstacle or falling into a gap. The game tracks distance travelled and speeds up over time, encouraging high scores.

1: // Minimal endless runner with improved graphics
2: // Assumes there is a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Ensure canvas fills its display size
7:   canvas.style.width = '100%';
8:   canvas.style.height = '100%';
9:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Audio setup
12:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
13:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
14:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
15:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   }
23:   function playJumpSound() { playTone(400, 0.1); }
24:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(100, 0.3); }
25:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
26:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
27: 
28:   // Game settings
29:   let speed = 4; // pixels per frame
30:   const speedIncrement = 0.001; // accelerate over time
31: 
32:   // Player properties
33:   const player = {
34:     w: 30,
35:     h: 30,
36:     x: 50,
37:     y: height - 30,
38:     vy: 0,
39:     jumpStrength: -12,
40:     onGround: true,
41:   };
42: 
43:   // Obstacle properties (simple rectangles)
44:   const obstacles = [];
45:   const obstacleGap = 200; // distance between obstacles
46:   let lastObstacleX = width;
47: 
48:   // Input handling – space to jump
49:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
50:     if (e.code === 'Space' && player.onGround) {
51:       // Ensure audio context is running
52:       if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
53:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
54:       player.onGround = false;
55:       playJumpSound();
56:     }
57:   });
58:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
59:     if (e.code === 'Space' && player.onGround) {
60:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
61:       player.onGround = false;
62:     }
63:   });
64: 
65:   let distance = 0;
66: 
67:   function spawnObstacle() {
68:     // Random height and type (spike vs block) – simple block for now
69:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
70:     obstacles.push({
71:       w: 20,
72:       h,
73:       x: width,
74:       y: height - h,
75:     });
76:   }
77: 
78:   function update() {
79:     // Existing update logic remains unchanged
80: 
81:     // Move player
82:     player.vy += 0.6; // gravity
83:     player.y += player.vy;
84:     if (player.y >= height - player.h) {
85:       player.y = height - player.h;
86:       player.vy = 0;
87:       player.onGround = true;
88:     }
89: 
90:     // Move obstacles
91:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       obstacles[i].x -= speed;
93:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
94:       if (obstacles[i].x + obstacles[i].w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Spawn new obstacles based on distance
98:     if (width - lastObstacleX >= obstacleGap) {
99:       spawnObstacle();
100:       lastObstacleX = width;
101:     } else {
102:       lastObstacleX -= speed;
103:     }
104: 
105:     // Collision detection
106:     for (const obs of obstacles) {
107:       if (
108:         player.x < obs.x + obs.w &&
109:         player.x + player.w > obs.x &&
110:         player.y < obs.y + obs.h &&
111:         player.y + player.h > obs.y
112:       ) {
113:         // Game over – stop loop
114:         cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
115:         ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
116:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
117:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
118:         return;
119:       }
120:     }
121: 
122:     // Update speed and distance
123:     distance += speed;
124:     speed += speedIncrement;
125:   }
126: 
127:   function draw() {
128:     drawBackground();
129:     drawPlayer();
130:     drawObstacles();
131:     drawHUD();
132:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
133:     // Draw player
134:     ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
135:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
136:     // Draw obstacles
137:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
138:     for (const obs of obstacles) {
139:       ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h);
140:     }
141:     // Draw distance
142:     ctx.fillStyle = 'green';
143:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
144:     ctx.fillText(`Distance: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, 10, 20);
145:   }
146: 
147:   function loop() {
148:     update();
149:     draw();
150:     frameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151:   }
152: 
153:   let frameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154: })();
